answer: Farming becomes a ripple bet on surviving 43 epochs of grading, and every vine settlement recomputes the zenith schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 12 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 43 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 30 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
